layout.arrangement: Figure-only slide. Maroon outer frame; pale-yellow badge '49' top-right; centered white panel with red border containing one scatter plot with dotted gray grid: dense tiny light-red background dots, larger red dots in an annulus centered ~(20,18) plus outer fill, blue cluster left-center, black cluster right-center.

regions.name: chart
regions.content: Axes box with dotted grid and three scatter series

visual_elements.description: Scatter axes, black spines, white bg, dotted gray grid #A6A6A6 at x=0,10,20,30,40 and y=0,5,...,35; ticks only readable values
Dense tiny light-red/pink background dots #F2A0A0 on grid over whole plot (2-3 px)
Larger red dots #E60000 (6-8 px) forming annulus/ring centered ~(20,18) radius ~10-12 plus outer-area fill

typography_notes: Sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica, MATLAB-style). Axis ticks ~10 pt regular black; y right-aligned, x centered. Badge '49' ~15-16 pt regular black centered. No bold/italic/title; digits only.
recreation_brief: 1. White 960x540 canvas. 2. Maroon stroke rectangle inset [60,40,903,500] (#9C1C31). 3. Pale-yellow circle with purple ring top-right, center ~(878,73), r~17, black '49'. 4. White panel with red 1-2px border [207,75,765,466] (#C8102E). 5. Black-spined axes rectangle [240,88,728,436] on white. 6. Dotted gray gridlines #A6A6A6 at x=0,10,20,30,40 and y=0..35 step 5. 7. Tick labels: y left of axes 35..0 top-to-bottom; x below 0..40; ~10 pt black. 8. Dense tiny light-red dots across full axes. 9. Larger red dots in ring centered ~(20,18) plus outer fill. 10. Blue cluster left-center x 9-18, y 10-24. 11. Black cluster right-center x 20-30, y 9-22.
